audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1 and 2 read Skill while whys[0] and whys[1] both say Teemo owns them, and the last row gave the stage to Teemo while whys[6] says Sett's gap-close out-scales his poke.
audit.why: Sett has no gap-closer until Facebreaker at 3, so the first two levels belong to Blinding Dart and Move Quick; by two items a single connection kills Teemo.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Skill, Skill, Teemo, Sett with inverse ratings 3/3/5/5/5/3/6 — the exact mirror of the already-audited teemo__sett entry. phases[0].why and phases[1].why rewritten so the reasons match the new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a suppression pick with no numbers.
audit.why: The Show Stopper is 400 range on 120s at rank 1 — it is a gap-closer you spend to reach him, not a finisher, and that is what makes 6 a real spike against a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and wants.you[1] carry the 400 range and 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeated 'Blinding Dart negates your autos' four times without ever saying it blinds BASIC ATTACKS ONLY.
audit.why: Facebreaker, Haymaker and The Show Stopper all land while blinded — only Knuckle Down's punches are wasted. That single fact turns the lane from 'wait 7 seconds' into 'commit the spell pattern anyway', and Haymaker's centre is true damage on top.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t with the flat 7s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned that Toxic Shot is on-hit.
audit.why: His damage scales with attack speed and applies item effects, so reading the trade as 'build MR' alone is wrong — the chip continues for 4 seconds after every attack.
audit.corrected: Written into dontsFull[1].d alongside the shroom slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and whys[4] wrote 'Show Stopper'; spikes[1] also asserted a suppression.
audit.why: The ability is The Show Stopper, and Riot's text calls it a carry-and-slam — suppression is not stated anywhere in this data.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten; the suppression claim replaced with the range and cooldown.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Negates your autos. All-in when down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: 7s at every rank — it blinds basic attacks only, so your E, W and R all land through it.

edits.before: Negates your autos. All-in when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 7s flat. It stops punches, not spells — E-stun and cash W straight through.

edits.before: Track Teemo's Blinding Dart: Negates your autos. All-in when down. When it is down — E-stun + W him.
edits.after: Blinding Dart only blinds basic attacks — Facebreaker, Haymaker and R land blinded. Q is wasted, though.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Noxious Trap slows, and Toxic Shot on-hit chips you the whole way in.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Teemo on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s and turns off your punches for its duration, and you have no gap-closer yet. Farm the level; take chip only when the dart is spent.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Teemo and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before he can answer with Blinding Dart.
edits.after: Move Quick keeps him outside your punch range while Toxic Shot chips for free. Knuckle Down's speed is not enough yet — wait for Facebreaker.

edits.before: Show Stopper is a clean pick on Teemo: suppress him through his blind and shrooms, since he has no dash or stun to break it.
edits.after: The Show Stopper is 400 range on a 120s rank-1 cooldown — blind does not stop it, so spend it to close, not to finish.

edits.before: Level 6 Show Stopper locks him through blind and shrooms.
edits.after: At 6 The Show Stopper closes 400 units through the blind.

edits.before: Use R to lock him through blind, shrooms, and Move Quick
edits.after: Use R to close the last 400 units — blind won't stop it
